context.body: When Saul had returned from following the Philistines, he was told, “Behold, David is in the wilderness of En Gedi.”.
context.label: Narrative or literary frame

observations.body: David cuts Saul’s robe, is struck in heart, restrains his men, speaks from a distance, and receives Saul’s recognition and requested oath.
observations.label: Power is restrained in the cave: textual observation

observations.body: The passage keeps David, Saul, and their men, the sheepfolds and cave at En Gedi, entering, cutting, being struck in heart, restraining, bowing, arguing, weeping, and swearing visible within David's story or later memory.
observations.label: Power is restrained in the cave: action, promise, or consequence

observations.body: David, Saul, and their men · the sheepfolds and cave at En Gedi · entering, cutting, being struck in heart, restraining, bowing, arguing, weeping, and swearing · a spared life produces confession and an oath without ending the pursuit
observations.label: Relationships named in 1 Samuel 24:1–22

payload.posture: Read 1 Samuel 24:1–22 as its own flight, covenant, and restraint David setting before carrying its language into another source.
payload.tension: The source places a spared life produces confession and an oath without ending the pursuit inside this David setting without explaining every motive, transition, or later consequence.
payload.title: Power is restrained in the cave
